descriptorSource: ext_String_asZnUrl	^ GtGemStoneExtensionMethod new		className: #String;		selector: #'asZnUrl';		meta: false;		protocol: #'*Zinc-Resource-Meta-Core';		gtVersions: nil;		hash: '6f92cdede440f2cd6d730c2511d047d967a40107a97f019ffdb6c69001268045';		source: 'asZnUrl	<gtGsExtension>	| zinc |	zinc := Globals at: #ZincGlobals ifAbsent: [ nil ].	^ (zinc		ifNil: [ ZnUrl ]		ifNotNil: [ zinc at: #ZnUrl ]) fromString: self'
targetSource: asZnUrl	<gtGsExtension>	| zinc |	zinc := Globals at: #ZincGlobals ifAbsent: [ nil ].	^ (zinc		ifNil: [ ZnUrl ]		ifNotNil: [ zinc at: #ZnUrl ]) fromString: self
reason: Prefer the installed private ZincGlobals ZnUrl identity during normal full GT reload; retain the original GT fallback when Zinc is absent.
historicalEvidence: shared-kernel-provenance.json records the original pre-integration GT bodies; this artifact records the current full GT reload adapters.

descriptorSource: ext_String_addedToZnUrl_	^ GtGemStoneExtensionMethod new		className: #String;		selector: #'addedToZnUrl:';		meta: false;		protocol: #'*Zinc-Resource-Meta-Core';		gtVersions: nil;		hash: #new;		source: 'addedToZnUrl: url	<gtGsExtension>	| zinc segments |	zinc := Globals at: #ZincGlobals ifAbsent: [ nil ].	segments := self subStrings: ''/''.	(zinc notNil and: [ url isKindOf: (zinc at: #ZnUrl) ])		ifTrue: [ segments := segments reject: [ :segment | segment isEmpty ] ].	^ url withPathSegments: segments'
targetSource: addedToZnUrl: url	<gtGsExtension>	| zinc segments |	zinc := Globals at: #ZincGlobals ifAbsent: [ nil ].	segments := self subStrings: '/'.	(zinc notNil and: [ url isKindOf: (zinc at: #ZnUrl) ])		ifTrue: [ segments := segments reject: [ :segment | segment isEmpty ] ].	^ url withPathSegments: segments
reason: Retain native omission of empty path segments for private Zinc URLs while preserving existing GT subStrings: behavior for other URL identities.
historicalEvidence: shared-kernel-provenance.json records the original pre-integration GT bodies; this artifact records the current full GT reload adapters.
